primitives.note: Starcall deals its magic damage once, on a delay after cast based on target distance (0.25 to 1s), on Q's cooldown

Starcall's travel time before it lands (and thus deals damage) scales with the distance from Soraka to the target location (0.25s at 50 range to 1s at 800 range); the dummy fight must assume a cast distance
Equinox's initial magic damage instance fires immediately on cast against enemies in the zone
Equinox is a two-part ability: an instant damage instance on cast, then the zone erupts 1.5s later for a second, separately-timed instance of the same damage
Mana costs (Q 45-65, E 70-90) against a base mana pool can constrain how many casts of the only two damaging abilities fit into the 15s window, especially before level 6+/blue buff/mana items

Salvation (movement speed while facing a low-health ally), Astral Infusion (ally heal, costs Soraka's own health), and Wish (global self/ally heal) deal no damage and are never read by the damage fight; they only matter for the survival fight as self-sustain
Astral Infusion costs Soraka 10% of her maximum health (reduced if she has Rejuvenation from Starcall) in addition to mana; relevant to survival-fight self-sustain, not to damage output

needsBespoke.why: Soraka has only two damage-dealing abilities. Starcall (Q) is a single delayed hit on cooldown (plain-cast, with a distance-dependent travel time the fight must assume) and Equinox (E) is a two-part multipart ability (instant cast damage, then a same-size eruption damage instance ~1.5s later). Mana costs are modest but worth tracking as resource-budget. Everything else in the kit (passive, W, R) is a heal/mobility effect that a damage-only dummy fight never reads. No bespoke logic beyond the existing primitives is required.

unsettled.question: What target distance should be assumed for Starcall's (Q) travel-time delay, since the delay scales linearly with distance from 0.25s at 50 range up to 1s at 800 range?
options: Assume point-blank/minimum range (~0.25s delay, fastest damage application)
quotes: grants sight of the area before landing after {{pp|type=target range|0.25 to 1 for 16|50 to 800}} seconds

unsettled.question: Does Equinox's eruption (second damage instance) apply automatically to a target that was hit by the initial cast damage and remains stationary in the zone, i.e. is the bin's single SorakaE#TotalDamage calculation applied twice (matching the wiki's explicit '70*2 to 170*2' doubled total), or could conditions (e.g. spellshield on one instance only) cause only one instance to land?
options: Both instances always land on a stationary dummy (total damage = 2x SorakaE#TotalDamage, per wiki's explicit doubling)
Only the guaranteed on-cast instance is certain; the eruption instance is conditional on the target remaining in the 260-radius zone for 1.5s
quotes: Afterwards, the zone erupts to deal the same damage to enemy champions within and root them for a duration.

proposal: Open by casting Equinox (E) as soon as it is off cooldown at the start of the fight, since its long cooldown (16-20s depending on rank) means it can typically only be cast once or twice in the 15s window; this lands its instant on-cast damage immediately and its eruption damage ~1.5s later.

Cast Starcall (Q) immediately after E, then recast Q every time it comes off cooldown for the remainder of the fight, since Q's short cooldown (4-8s depending on rank) allows several casts within 15s and it is Soraka's primary repeatable damage source.
Do not cast Astral Infusion (W) or Wish (R) during the damage fight; they deal zero damage and only cost mana/health that would otherwise fund Q casts.
Basic-attack the target between Q casts if no ability is available, though Soraka's low base AD makes this a minor damage contributor relative to Q and E.
questions: At what champion level and ability ranks is the damage fight run, since Q's cooldown (4-8s) and cost (45-65) and E's cooldown (16-20s) vary by rank and materially change how many casts fit in 15s?
What target distance should be assumed for Starcall's travel delay (affects when Q's damage actually lands, and thus kill time, though not total damage)?
Is a second cast of Equinox (E) realistically achievable within 15s at low ranks (20s cooldown), or should the rotation assume only a single E cast for most of the simulated level range?
